exposure: operative hysteroscopy using the Intrauterine Bigatti Shaver (IBS ®)
outcome: efficacy and feasibility of operative hysteroscopy
cohort: 65 patients suspected of retained products of conception (RPOC) who underwent operative hysteroscopy between December 2013 and April 2018
finding: The IBS ® appears to be an effective and safe instrument for the removal of placental remnants, allowing for short operation time with a high success and low complication rate.
